Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A contact form submission, project quote request, or emergency software issue ticket submitted by a client.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inquiry record.

type.description: The category of the client message or submission.

serviceType.description: Requested software service or issue category.

message.description: Detailed project description or bug report.

affectedUrlOrSystem.description: URL or server affected by bug.

preferredContact.description: Preferred channel: WhatsApp, Phone Call, or Email.

adminNotes.description: Internal notes by Ocean Technologies administrator.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the inquiry was created.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Public client submissions (quotes, contact messages, and emergency bug tickets) with admin workflow management.
